caption: Shared-input edge arms at the 35-epoch configuration. Points show each arm minus the raw no-edges reference in pooled observed-entry root mean squared error (RMSE) at the 12-hour horizon, in cohort-A training standard-deviation units; negative is better. Whiskers are pointwise 95% paired Student t intervals over four matched training seeds (3 degrees of freedom). Shading is plus/minus the admissible-minus-none minimum detectable difference (MDD), using exact two-sided noncentral-t inversion at 80% power and alpha=0.05 with the observed four-pair standard deviation. MDD is a planning sensitivity estimate, not an equivalence margin. Intervals describe training-seed variation conditional on the fixed cohorts, do not estimate patient or hospital sampling uncertainty, and are unadjusted for multiple contrasts. Raw no edges bypasses coupling normalisation; the normalised and parameter-matched no-edges controls change different aspects of the model. Random draws 1-3 map to random_s0, random_s1 and random_s2; Misspecified maps to misspecified-1.
x_label: arm minus no edges (pooled RMSE); negative is better
